REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - OCTOBER 2, 2019 - CITY HALL -
7:00
P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS:
Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the Community Development Department, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m.
to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1201. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Cerritos Planning Commission after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Community Development Department at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time
each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the meeting will not
exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless
determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate
responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the
agenda, unless otherwise directed. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially
the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, public hearing is opened, and
report of written correspondence and staff report are received. Verbal testimony will occur
in the following order: those in favor of the application/item, those opposed, interested
parties, rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested to state their name and city of
residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the
matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the public
hearing.

A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 2019-10, A PROPOSAL BY THE RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY OWNERS TO RECONFIGURE THE FIRST FLOOR AND CONSTRUCT A NEW SECOND FLOOR TO AN EXISTING ONE-STORY RESIDENCE AT 17400 LA BONITA WAY, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENTIAL (RS-5000) (APN 7022-020-016).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 20: PRESENTATION PACKET
B.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION APPROVING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PERMIT 2002-5(2019) RENEWAL, A REQUEST BY APPLICANT CORE DEVELOPMENT SERVICES, ON BEHALF OF VERIZON WIRELESS, TO RENEW AN EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY ON A SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA EDISON TRANSMISSION TOWER. THE EXISTING WIRELESS FACILITY CONTAINS NINE (9) PANEL ANTENNAS, SIX (6) REMOTE RADIO UNITS, ONE (1) MICROWAVE DISH ANTENNA, ONE (1) RAYCAP, AND ONE (1) GLOBAL POSITIONING ANTENNA MOUNTED ON THE TOWER, AND LOCATED BENEATH THE TOWER IS AN EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE THAT CONTAINS ONE (1) SUPPORT EQUIPMENT CABINET. THE EXISTING EQUIPMENT ENCLOSURE ALSO CONTAINS ONE (1) BACK-UP GENERATOR FOR WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION PURPOSES. NO CHANGES ARE PLANNED FOR THE EXISTING WIRELESS TELECOMMUNICATION FACILITY AS PART OF THE RENEWAL REQUEST. THE SUBJECT TOWER IS LOCATED AT 10755½ ARTESIA BOULEVARD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA, 90703 AND IS ZONED OPEN SPACE OVERLAY (OS-1) (APN 7034-001-803).*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
AGENDA REPORT
EXHIBIT 20: PRESENTATION PACKET
C.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING THAT THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL APPROVE DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2019-5, A REQUEST TO AMEND CHAPTER 5.35 AND CHAPTER 22.40 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO PROHIBIT THE SALE OF ELECTRONIC CIGARETTES IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS.*
*Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.
